initiation of appressorium by symbiont on or near host
initiation of symbiont appressorium on or near host

definition: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell starts to acquire specialized features of the symbiont appressorium to aid in infection of the host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: initiation of appressorium formation
